sections.heading: Professional Foundation Excavation and Backfilling
sections.body: Your foundation sets the stage for the entire structure. Our team provides accurate, safe, and efficient foundation excavation and backfilling for builders, contractors, and homeowners throughout Brant County and the surrounding area. We ensure the right depth, clean lines, proper soil handling, and reliable compaction - everything required for a strong, stable foundation.

sections.subheading: Best fit for foundation work that needs accurate elevations, spoil handled cleanly, and backfill support that keeps the next trade moving.

cards.title: New homes, garages, and additions
cards.body: A strong fit when you need a crew that can cut to plan, manage spoil without leaving the site buried, and leave the excavation ready for footing and wall work.

cards.title: Walkouts, stepped grades, and awkward access
cards.body: Useful on sites where slope, staging, or tighter access affects how the dig has to be sequenced and how material is moved around the lot.

cards.body: A practical fit when the same job needs controlled backfill, compaction, rough grading, and a clean handoff after waterproofing and foundation work are complete.
cards.outcome: Brings the site back to a stable, workable condition instead of leaving backfill and grading for separate cleanup later.

sections.heading: What a Bellhouse Foundation Excavation Includes
sections.subheading: We handle every stage of the excavation, from layout to spoil removal to final grading, so your foundation is structurally ready and builder-approved.

items.title: Full Basement & Addition Excavation
items.body: We dig to engineered depth and specifications, ensuring accurate grades, clean edges, and safe soil management.

items.title: Over-Excavation & Soil Removal
items.body: When poor soil is discovered, we remove unsuitable material and haul it away with our triaxle fleet.

items.title: Professional Backfilling
items.body: We supply and place granular A or B material, ensuring proper lift thickness and long-term stability around the foundation.

items.title: Compaction for Structural Stability
items.body: Using a diesel plate tamper or roller, we compact the backfill to prevent future settling and drainage issues.

items.title: Rough Grading for Drainage
items.body: We shape the site around the home to direct water away from the structure and prepare the area for landscaping or construction.

items.title: Trucking & Spoil Removal
items.body: Our three triaxle dump trucks haul away all excess soil, keeping your site clean and ready for the next phase.

sections.heading: What Foundation Excavation Planning Prevents
sections.subheading: Foundation excavation goes smoother when layout, trucking, backfill, and drainage planning are handled before small site issues turn into rework.

items.problem: Cuts that drift off plan or grade can slow footing work before concrete even starts.
items.solution: Bellhouse reviews drawings, confirms elevations, and excavates to engineered depth with clean lines and controlled soil handling.

items.problem: Spoil left stacked around the dig can choke access and disrupt the next trade.
items.solution: Excess material is hauled out with Bellhouse dump trucks so footing, wall, and delivery crews can keep moving.

items.problem: Loose or poorly placed backfill leads to settlement and drainage trouble after the foundation is in.
items.solution: Backfill is placed in controlled lifts, compacted properly, and rough graded to support long-term stability around the structure.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse Excavating is fully licensed and insured for residential, agricultural, and commercial excavation across Ontario, and documentation is available on request.

items.question: Do I need drawings before getting a quote?
items.answer: No. A site address, a description of the scope, and access details are enough to start. Drawings and photos help us price more accurately, but a call or message works fine before plans are finalized.

items.question: How long does a foundation excavation take?
items.answer: Most residential foundation digs are completed in one to a few days, depending on size, depth, soil conditions, and trucking volume. We confirm a realistic timeline after reviewing the site.

items.question: Do you remove all excess soil?
items.answer: Yes. Our triaxle fleet hauls away all spoil material as part of our excavation service, so the site stays clear for the next phase.

items.question: Can you work in tight backyards?
items.answer: In most cases, yes. We assess access during the estimate and plan equipment size accordingly so we can reach constrained or rear-lot foundations.

items.question: How far ahead should I book?
items.answer: Most projects book one to three weeks in advance depending on the season. Send your location and timing and we will give you a straight answer on availability.
